name: Igor' Dulgarovich Budaev
source:
Byasha is an Asian boy with slanted eyes (Buryat by nationality). He has shaved temples and thick black bangs. As a result of the accident, Byasha lacks two central incisors of the upper jaw, which is why he lisps.

At school, the boy wears a knitted lemon-yellow sweater with a dark turquoise collar, cuffs and stripes. In the center of the sweater is embroidered the inscription Tear BOYZ, jeans and boots with fur upholstery.
